name: Skillsmith
description: Create, test and vet SKILL.md skills for any coding agent.

skills.name: write-a-skill
skills.description: Write a new skill that coding agents will find and follow, then check it with skillsmith.

skills.name: vet-untrusted-skill
skills.description: Check a third-party skill, inside an E2B sandbox when possible, before you install it.

skills.name: audit-skill-library
skills.description: Check every skill in a folder and fix what stops agents from finding or following them, worst first.
